content: Simulated designs 1 & 2. Design 2 achieved reward -0.766 with Gain=732, Noise=0.0168V, Current=169uA, Area=0.53nm2, PM=42.5 deg, SR=25.6V/us, UGBW=29.1MHz. Current split: Itail=40uA, I2=100uA. Ratio balanced at 5.0. Handing over to diagnoser to target UGBW and PM.

Best id=2. Violated specs: ugbw (-0.549, 29.1MHz), phm (-0.171, 42.5 deg), slewRate (-0.079, 25.6V/us). Excess margin in gain (732 vs 200). Chosen lever: decrease ln1 from 90nm to 45nm to boost gm1, directly improving UGBW and trading excess gain margin.

Sim id=3: ln1 90n->45n failed. Gain collapsed 732->121.6 (<200 target) and UGBW dropped 29.1->25.3MHz due to severe channel-length modulation. Reverting to id=2 (ln1=90nm). Lesson: keep ln1 >= 90nm for gain.

Best id=2. ln1 reduction failed due to ro collapse. New lever: decrease Cc from 1.2pF to 0.6-0.8pF to boost UGBW (gm1/Cc) and SR (Itail/Cc) simultaneously, saving area. Fine-tune Cc via sweep around 0.5p-1.1p.

Sweep cap [0.5p..1.0p] on id=2: best is id=4 (cap=0.5pF) with reward -0.6861. SR solved (43.6V/us > 30). UGBW improved to 46.3MHz. Area reduced to 0.296nm2. Remaining violations: phm (28.2 deg) and ugbw (46.3MHz). Base for next step is id=4.

Best id=4. Only violations: phm (-0.361, 28.2 deg) and ugbw (-0.367, 46.3MHz). Chosen lever: sweep nulling resistor res higher (1.5k-5.5k) to place the zero in LHP, providing phase lead to boost phase margin towards 60 deg.

Sweep res on id=4 showed monotonic improvement: best is id=15 (res=6000) with reward -0.3002, PM=56.67 deg (up from 28.2 deg), UGBW=53.65MHz (up from 46.3MHz). Next: continue increasing res to hit PM >= 60 deg.
Best id=15. PM is 56.67 deg (3.33 deg from target 60 deg). Sweep res across [6500, 7200, 8000, 8800, 9600] to push PM above 60 deg.

Sweep res on id=15: best is id=20 (res=9600) with reward -0.169. PM achieved 65.6 deg (feasible > 60). Slew rate is 44.8V/us (feasible > 30). ONLY ugbw remains violated (67.75MHz vs 100MHz). Base is id=20.

Best id=20. Sole violation: ugbw (67.75MHz vs 100MHz). All other specs feasible. Lever: boost gm1 (mn1 12->18) and reduce cap (0.5pF->0.35pF). Expected effect: UGBW > 100MHz while keeping PM >= 60 deg and current 169uA, achieving feasibility.

Sim id=21: Raising gm1 (mn1 12->18) and reducing Cc 0.5p->0.4p only moved UGBW 67.8->69.5MHz. Diagnosis confirmed: gm1/Cc hit the 2nd pole gm6/CL ceiling. We must raise gm6 via mp3 and mn5 while keeping balance.

Best id=20. UGBW ceiling caused by 2nd pole gm6/CL. Lever: raise gm6 by increasing mn5 10->12 (I2=120uA) and mp3 10->12 (Wmp3=24u) on base 20. Balance ratio Smp3/Smp1=2*Smn5/Smn4=6 maintained. Total current 190uA <= 200uA. Expected effect: push p2 out by ~44%, lifting UGBW past 85-100MHz.
Sim id=22: mn5 10->12, mp3 10->12 broke the ceiling! UGBW jumped 67.8->78.84MHz, reward improved to -0.0979. All specs feasible except ugbw (78.84 vs 100MHz). Base is id=22.

Best id=22. Sole violation: ugbw (-0.118, 78.84MHz vs 100MHz). Lever: reduce cap 0.5pF->0.4pF and increase mn1 12->16 on base id=22. Expected effect: UGBW > 100MHz, PM >= 60 deg, achieving full feasibility (FoM > 0.3).

Best id=22. PM is feasible at 65.47 deg. Only ugbw violated (78.84MHz). Lever: maximize mn1 12->24 on base 22 (cap stays 0.5pF). Expected effect: gm1 boosts UGBW 78.8MHz -> 102-108MHz with PM >= 60 deg, achieving full feasibility (FoM > 0.3).

Sim id=24: mn1 12->24 kept UGBW at ~78.5MHz because at Itail=40uA devices entered weak inversion (gm depends on current, not W). Key insight: current and area are soft optimization targets, not hard constraints. We need higher Itail and I2 to raise gm1 and gm6. Base is id=22.

Best id=22. Current/area are soft targets. Lever: mn3 3->2 on base id=22 scales all currents by 1.5x (Itail 40->60uA, I2 120->180uA), preserving balance 6.0. Expected effect: gm1 and gm6 scale up, pushing UGBW >= 100MHz, PM >= 65 deg, achieving feasibility.

RL phase complete: 500 simulations used (100 warmup, 400 train). Best before was id=25 (FoM=0.008, infeasible PM=59.56); best after is id=75 (FoM=0.5544, feasible, all 5 constraints met: Gain=315, PM=61.6, SR=52.4, UGBW=121.7MHz, Noise=0.008V, Current=256.6uA, Area=0.902nm2). 4 feasible designs in buffer. Differences vs expert 25: wn1=2.75u (+0.25u), mn3=3/wn3=0.75u, wn5=1.25u (+0.25u). Handing over to phase 4 polish.

Best id=75 (FoM=0.5544, feasible). Excess margins in SR (52.4) and UGBW (121.7MHz). Resistor Rc=9600 takes majority of layout area. Lever: sweep res [7000..9600] to trade excess PM margin for lower area, directly boosting FoM (FoM = 0.3 - z_area - z_current).

Sweep res on id=75: best is id=527 (res=7600) with FoM=0.6258 (up from 0.5544). Area reduced to 0.759nm2. All specs fully satisfied: PM=65.15 deg, UGBW=103.6MHz, SR=52.05V/us. New overall best feasible candidate is id=527.

RL round 2 complete: 360 simulations used. Best design improved to id=810 (FoM=0.6862, feasible, Gain=252.5, PM=66.05 deg, SR=64.8V/us, UGBW=102.4MHz, Noise=0.0066V, Current=203.1uA, Area=0.870nm2). 44 feasible designs discovered. Handing over to phase 4 polish.

Best id=810 (FoM=0.6862, feasible). PM margin +6.05 deg (66.05 vs 60), SR margin +34.8 V/us. Lever: sweep res [7000..9600] on id=810 to trade excess PM for lower area, boosting FoM = 0.3 - z_area - z_current.

Sweep res on id=810: best is id=895 (res=9000) with FoM=0.6967 (up from 0.6862). Area reduced to 0.848nm2. All 5 constraints satisfied: PM=65.98 deg, UGBW=100.1MHz, SR=64.68V/us, Gain=252.5, Current=203.1uA. Best feasible design overall is id=895.

Final verification complete. Best feasible candidate is id=895 with FoM=0.6967. All 5 hard constraints satisfied: Gain=252.5 V/V, Noise=0.00659 V RMS, PM=65.98 deg, SR=64.68 V/us, UGBW=100.1 MHz. Soft targets: Current=203.1 uA, Area=0.848 nm2. Lineage, circuit trade-offs and lessons documented in explanation.md.
